content.user_title: Find Companies and Retrieve Metix Records
content.value_statement: Company research requires valid filters, complete records, and controlled API usage. This skill guides Metix searches using the live contract, batched detail retrieval, and pagination.
actual_capabilities: Read the live company contract to select supported fields, operators, and enumerated values.
Search company IDs using industry and company-size filters supported by the contract.
Retrieve company records in batches of up to 100 IDs with selected output fields.
Paginate company searches using the returned cursor while preserving the original filters.
Use structured error codes and linked documentation to investigate rejected requests.
Authenticate using METIX_KEY and stop when the variable is missing.
limitations: Requires network access and a valid METIX_KEY for authenticated company requests.
Search returns IDs, not company records; retrieving details requires a separate request.
Available fields, operators, enumerations, and pricing depend on the live Metix service.
Does not provide contact unlocking; email and phone requests belong to the separate metix-people-search skill.

use_cases.title: Build Target Account Lists
use_cases.description: Find companies matching an industry and size segment, then retrieve selected records for account review.

use_cases.title: Map Industry Segments
use_cases.description: Compare company records across contract-supported segments while following pagination and reporting the filters used.

use_cases.title: Retrieve Company Data Efficiently
use_cases.description: Fetch selected fields for known company IDs in batches and consult current credit rules before large requests.

prompt_templates.title: Find a First Company Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 biotechnology companies with size 51-200 or larger in Metix. Validate the filters first, then retrieve names and industries.

prompt_templates.title: Select Company Record Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve records for these company IDs: [company IDs]. Return name, industry, size, and headquarters country where available. Validate fields and batch requests.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Paginated Segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Research companies matching [industry] and [size range]. Validate filters, retrieve at most [maximum companies], preserve filters across pages, and summarize available records.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Credit-Constrained Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a company search for [segment] within [API Credit budget]. Check current pricing, explain supported filters, and request approval before paid calls.

output_examples.input: Find biotechnology companies with size 51-200 or larger and show company names and industries.
output: Illustrative response structure, not live company results.
Validated filters: biotechnology industry and the supported company-size threshold.
Requested record fields: company name and industry.
Results would appear after authenticated search and detail retrieval.

output_examples.input: Search for companies when METIX_KEY is not set.
output: Set METIX_KEY in your environment before making authenticated company requests.
No other credential variables or local files were searched.

output_examples.input: Use company search to find a person's email address.
output_examples.output: Contact details require the separate metix-people-search skill and its contact unlock workflow. Company search does not provide this operation.

best_practices: Read the live contract before selecting fields, operators, and enumerated values.
Batch detail retrieval and review current credit pricing before large searches.
Keep METIX_KEY in the environment and exclude it from files, logs, and summaries.
anti_patterns: Treating company search IDs as complete company records.
Inventing filter fields or reusing operators without checking the live contract.
Searching local files for replacement credentials when METIX_KEY is missing.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It guides company searches, batched record retrieval, pagination, and error handling through the Metix API.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Actual requests require an environment with API access and suitable request tools.

faq.question: How do I provide authentication?
faq.answer: Set METIX_KEY in the environment. The skill stops when it is missing and prohibits printing or saving the key.

faq.question: Does a company search return full records?
faq.answer: No. Search returns company IDs; the detail endpoint retrieves selected record fields for up to 100 IDs per request.

faq.question: Are API calls free?
faq.answer: The skill lists contract, version, and key-status checks as free. Result operations consume API Credits according to current Metix pricing.

faq.question: Can this skill retrieve email addresses or phone numbers?
faq.answer: No. It directs contact requests to metix-people-search and the contact unlock capability.
